Ravi: Heads-up: we are GA-ing the new Hosted OpenAPI Streams + Edge-Lite tool-calling feature set today. This is an internal launch callout — please treat customer-facing copy as embargoed until marketing publishes. :lock:
Mira: Key rollout notes: staged regional rollout over 3 hours, no forced migrations, new projects default to the OpenAPI Streams surface. We will provide an opt-in migration helper and 30-day aliasing for existing endpoints.
Jo: SDKs updated (Python/TS/Go) and pushed to staging. Quickstart snippets live in staging docs. Small API change: tool-calling in-stream requires header `X-Redwood-Tool-Call: true`.
Sam: Canary started in us-east-1 at 2012345690. Early telemetry looks good: p50 ~ 60ms, p95 ~ 200ms; error rate within baseline. Increasing canary to 10% for 30m.
eng-oncall: Watching logs and SLOs. Created dashboards and alert rules; will escalate if timeouts >0.5% or error spike.
Ravi: Dedicated customers get a control-plane toggle; Private will receive a patch next week and account teams will coordinate. No SLA changes in this launch.
marketing-bot: Draft announcement queued for 12:15pm PT. Please flag any legal/compliance flags.
Mira: Action list for the next hour: docs smoke tests, publish SDK release notes, customer email draft review, and support rotation brief. Tag me on urgent items.
deploy-bot: release/openapi-streams-edge@prod 1.0.0-ga deployed to canary nodes.
Ravi: Thank you all — big milestone for lower-latency tool-calls on edge models. We'll collect initial perf samples for Optimize and follow up with a short postmortem checklist in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :rocket:
